y-m-72-03.title: Kana mubairo uchikwira, mari yaunoenda nayo kumba inodzikira here?
y-m-72-03.topic: Mitero nema brackets nemubairo mushure memutero (mutemo we progressive)
y-m-72-03.goal: Shandisa zvakarurama poinzi yekuti kana ukapfuura muganhu we bracket, rate yemutero mutsva inoshanda pachikamu chiri pamusoro pemuganhu chete, kwete kumubairo wese, uye ugadzire iwe pachako mienzaniso apo mubairo mushure memutero unokwira kunyange kana avhareji yemutero ichikwira.
y-m-72-03.material:
Zvinotevera i mutemo wemutero wemubairo wakagadzirwa wakagadzirirwa basa iri (haisi mutemo chaiwo wemitero). Mubairo wegore (mu 만원) wakapatsanurwa kuita ma brackets, uye rate yebracket imwe neimwe inoshanda pahuwandu hunova mubracket iyoyo chete.
- Chikamu kusvika ku 4,000만원: 10%
- Chikamu pamusoro pe 4,000만원 kusvika ku 8,000만원: 20%
- Chikamu pamusoro pe 8,000만원: 30%
Mutero i huwandu hwemitero yezvikamu zvitatu izvi, uye mubairo mushure memutero i mubairo kubvisa mutero. Seoyun akagadzirisa achiti, 'Kana wapfuura 4,000만원 rate inova 20%, saka unorasikirwa chaizvo.'

Ruzivo rwekuverenga tebhura, kuenzanisa hukuru nekuongorora mamiriro einequality (mathematics yechikoro chepamusoro). Basa iri riri nhanho imwe pamusoro pekuoma kwekutanga.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.prompt: Fungidzira nepfungwa yeshopu X. Shopu Y inosarudza chii (kuchengeta kana kudzikisa), sarudzo ipi iri nani kuna X?
y-m-72-12.s.s1.hint.0: Kana Y ichichengeta, wana makosha maviri eprofit yaX mutebhura uye uaenzanise.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.hint.1: Wanawo makosha maviri eprofit yaX kana Y ichidzikisa uye uaenzanise, uye uongorore kana migumisiro yekuenzanisa kuviri yakafanana.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.o.a: Kana Y ichichengeta mutengo wayo, kudzikisa kuri nani, uye kana Y ichidzikisa, kuchengeta kuri nani.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.r.a: Kana Y ichidzikisa, X inowana 30 kana ichichengeta uye 40 kana ichidzikisa. Verenga zvakare nyaya iyoyo mutebhura.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.o.b: Kudzikisa kuri nani pasinei nesarudzo yaY. Munyaya dzose profit yekudzikisa yakakura.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.r.b: Kana Y ichichengeta, kudzikisa kwaX kunopa 80, kuri kukuru kupfuura 60 yekuchengeta, uye kana Y ichidzikisa, kudzikisa kwaX kunopa 40, kuri kukuru kupfuura 30 yekuchengeta.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.o.c: Kuchengeta kuri nani pasinei nesarudzo yaY. Kana vose vachichengeta, i60, iri huru zvikuru.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.r.c: 60 kana vose vachichengeta ndiyo inowanwa naX naY pamwe chete. Kana Y ichidzikisa, X inogona kuwana 30 chete kana ichichengeta.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.o.d: Tebhura yoga haigoni kuudza kana zvichienderana nesarudzo yaY.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.r.d: Kana ukaverenga tebhura uchipatsanura sarudzo yaY kuita nyaya mbiri, unogona kuona muimwe neimwe kuti sarudzo ipi inopa X profit huru.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.explain: Kana Y ichichengeta, kudzikisa kwaX (80) kukuru kupfuura kuchengeta (60), uye kana Y ichidzikisa, kudzikisa kwaX (40) kukuru kupfuura kuchengeta (30). Chero Y ichiita sei, kudzikisa kuri nani, saka X inoda kusarudza kudzikisa. Y ine chimiro chakafanana, saka kana vose vachidzikisa i(40, 40), kunyange kana kuchengeta vose kwakapa (60, 60) huru.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira iwe amene imwe payoff table ine chimiro chakafanana nepamusoro. T iprofit yaX kana X oga ichidzikisa, R kana vose vachichengeta, P kana vose vachidzikisa, uye S kana X oga ichichengeta (Y oga ichidzikisa). Kuchengeta chimiro chenyaya, T > R > P > S inofanira kushanda, uye huwandu hwemhindu nekurasikirwa kubva pakudzikisa kwedivi rimwe chete (T+S) hunofanira kuva pasi pekaviri profit yekuchengeta vose (2R). Gadzira mapoka maviri akasiyana emakosha mana asiyana netebhura iri pamusoro. (Maintegers kubva pa0 kusvika pa100)
y-m-72-12.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wanyora kurongeka kwehukuru kwenhamba ina dziri mutebhura iri pamusoro.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.hint.1: Chinja nhamba uchichengeta kurongeka, uye uongorore mamiriro ekupedzisira (2R kuenzaniswa ne T+S) nekuverenga iwe amene.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.var.T: Profit yaX kana X oga ichidzikisa (T)
y-m-72-12.s.s2.var.S: Profit yaX kana X oga ichichengeta (S)
y-m-72-12.s.s2.ok.c1: Makosha mana maintegers kubva pa0 kusvika pa100.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.fail.c1: Ndapota ita makosha mana maintegers kubva pa0 kusvika pa100.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.ok.c2: Profit T yekudzikisa oga yakakura kupfuura R yekuchengeta vose.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.fail.c2: T haina kukura kupfuura R. Kana mumwe achichengeta, kudzikisa kunofanira kuwana mhindu yakawanda.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.ok.c3: Kuchengeta vose (R) kukuru kupfuura kudzikisa vose (P).
y-m-72-12.s.s2.fail.c3: R haina kukura kupfuura P. Kana vose vachidzikisa, vose vanofanira kuva vakaipa.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.ok.c4: Kudzikisa vose (P) kukuru kupfuura kuchengeta oga (S).
y-m-72-12.s.s2.fail.c4: P haina kukura kupfuura S. Kana mumwe achidzikisa, kudzikisa kunofanira kuwana mhindu yakawandawo.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.ok.c5: Huwandu kana vose vachichengeta (2R) hukuru kupfuura huwandu kana mumwe chete achidzikisa (T+S).
y-m-72-12.s.s2.fail.c5: 2R haina kukura kupfuura T+S. Huwandu kana vose vachichengeta hunofanira kuva hukuru.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.ok.c6: Idzi nhamba dzakasiyana netebhura iri pamusoro.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.fail.c6: Idzi nhamba dzakafanana netebhura iri pamusoro. Dzigadzire nenhamba dzakasiyana.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.explain: Kana T>R>P>S sa (70, 50, 20, 10) uye 2R=100 yakakura kupfuura T+S=80, chimiro chenyaya chakafanana. Muchimiro ichi shopu imwe neimwe inowana mhindu nekusarudza kudzikisa, asi kana vose vachidzikisa, mhindu ishoma kupfuura kana vose vaichichengeta.
